title: Manufacturer/Packer/Importer Name & Address
description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, or packer, or importer must be declared on the package.

title: Common/Generic Name of Commodity
description: Common or generic name of the commodity must be declared.

title: Net Quantity in Standard SI Units
description: Net quantity in weight (g/kg), volume (ml/L), or number must be declared in standard SI units.

title: MRP with inclusive of all taxes
description: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) in rupees must be declared with the words 'inclusive of all taxes'.

title: Month & Year of Manufacture/Packing/Import
description: Month and year of manufacture or packing or import must be declared.

title: Consumer Care Details
description: Name and address of the person to whom complaints may be communicated, including phone number or email.

title: Country of Origin (Imported Goods)
description: For imported goods, country of origin must be declared.

title: Font Size per Package Tier
description: Minimum font height for net quantity declaration: <=200g/ml: 1mm, 200-500g/ml: 2mm, >500g/ml: 4mm.

title: MRP Integrity (No Overwriting/Sticker)
description: MRP shall not be overprinted, overwritten, or covered by a sticker. Must be clearly legible and permanent.

title: Unit Sale Price (Food >100g/ml)
description: For food commodities with net quantity exceeding 100g/ml, unit sale price per unit weight/volume must be declared.

title: No Misleading Terms Without Qualifiers
description: No misleading terms or claims that deceive consumers about quantity, quality, or nature of the product.

title: Declarations on Principal Display Panel
description: Mandatory declarations must appear on the Principal Display Panel (visible at point of sale).
